proposedSkills.name: Reference-Guided Visual Iteration
proposedSkills.description: Builds code-rendered visual work (3D scenes, video, games, UI) by repeatedly rendering stills, comparing them side by side with supplied reference images or video against a numeric per-dimension quality bar, scoring with independent fresh-context critics, and fixing the weakest dimension until the bar is met.

evidence.notes: MIT-licensed, single contributor, created 2026-10-31; 386 stars and 30 forks per GitHub API on 2026-11-13 (a fork burst that day has unknown cause). Method and performance claims are author-reported and not independently verified. Pinned review revision b23cac6f.
